v	1
2026-12-01	כ״א כסלו תשפ״ז	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	Why do we light Chanukah candles?	The Greeks banned Torah and mitzvot and defiled the Mikdash, until the Chashmonaim beat them on 25 Kislev. They found one jar of pure oil, enough for a day, and it lasted eight. So the Sages made these eight days of joy and Hallel, and we light each night to publicize the miracle.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 670:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2-%d7%93%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%90%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%91%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2B-B%D7%93%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%90%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%91%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%90	Chanukah	Do women have to light Chanukah candles?	Yes, they were part of the miracle too. A wife can light for the whole household. If her husband will be home late, it's right that he asks her to light on time, about a quarter of an hour after sunset.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 675:10	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%94-%d7%a9%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94-%d7%a2%d7%95%d7%a9%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%a6%d7%95%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%94B-B%D7%A9%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94B%D7%A2%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%A6%D7%95%D7%94-%D7%99
2026-12-02	כ״ב כסלו תשפ״ז	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	Which oil and wicks are best?	Any oil and wicks are kosher, but olive oil is best, since its light is clearest. Cotton wicks are best. Where there's no oil, wax candles are used.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 673:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%92-%d7%a9%d7%9e%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%95%d7%a4%d7%aa%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a9%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%9c%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%92B-B%D7%A9%D7%9E%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%95%D7%A4%D7%AA%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%9C%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%90	Chanukah	Can I use an electric menorah?	Not with a bracha. Many poskim hold electric lights don't fulfil the mitzvah, which needs oil and a wick like the Menorah. If you truly have no oil or candles, light it without a bracha, and light properly with a bracha if they turn up later.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 673:5	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%92-%d7%a9%d7%9e%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%95%d7%a4%d7%aa%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a9%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%9c%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%92B-B%D7%A9%D7%9E%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%95%D7%A4%D7%AA%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%9C%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%94
2026-12-03	כ״ג כסלו תשפ״ז	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	Does a new menorah need tevila?	No. Only vessels used for food need tevila.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 671, סדר הדלקת נר חנוכה ומקום הנחתו‎, §16	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%90-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94-%d7%95%d7%9e%d7%a7%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%a0%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%90B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94B%D7%95%D7%9E%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%97%D7%AA%D7%95-%D7%98%D7%96	Chanukah	Which brachot do I say when I light?	On the first night, three: "lehadlik ner Chanukah", "she'asa nissim" and "Shehecheyanu". On the other nights, only the first two.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 676:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%95B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94-%D7%90
2026-12-04	כ״ד כסלו תשפ״ז	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	On Friday, which do I light first: Chanukah or Shabbat candles?	Chanukah first, then Shabbat. If time is short, once he has lit one Chanukah light, his wife may light the Shabbat candles while he finishes the rest. Put the menorah where opening the door won't blow it out.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 679, 680, נר חנוכה בערב שבת‎, §1	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%98-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%a4-%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%98%2CB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%A4B-B%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%90	Chanukah	On Motzei Shabbat, do I make Havdala or light Chanukah first?	At home, make Havdala first, then light. In shul the custom is to light Chanukah before Havdala.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 681:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%90-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%90B-B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%91
2026-12-06	כ״ו כסלו תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	Which light do I light first?	On the first night, the one on the far right, farthest from the door. Each night after, start with the new light, nearest the door, and go left to right. That way the bracha is always on the added light.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 676:19	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%95B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%98	Chanukah	Can I light a regular candle or a cigarette from the Chanukah lights?	Not during the first half hour after lighting, which is the mitzvah time. After that you may, just as you may then use their light.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 674:3	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%93-%d7%9c%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%a7-%d7%9e%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%9c%d7%a0%d7%a8/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%93B-B%D7%9C%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%A7B%D7%9E%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%9C%D7%A0%D7%A8-%D7%92
2026-12-07	כ״ז כסלו תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	Can I eat dinner before lighting?	Not a proper meal, meaning more than an egg's volume of bread or cake, from half an hour before lighting time. A snack, fruit or a drink is fine.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 672:3	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%91-%d7%96%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%91B-B%D7%96%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%92	Chanukah	I'm a woman lighting on my own. Can I eat dinner first?	No, a woman who lights for herself also shouldn't eat a meal before lighting. If your husband lights for the family, you may eat if there's a need, especially when he's late, unless you've always been strict about it.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 672:4	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%91-%d7%96%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%91B-B%D7%96%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%93
2026-12-08	כ״ח כסלו תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	How long do I hold the flame to the wick?	Until most of the wick that sticks out has caught and the flame keeps going by itself.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 675:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%94-%d7%a9%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94-%d7%a2%d7%95%d7%a9%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%a6%d7%95%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%94B-B%D7%A9%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94B%D7%A2%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%A6%D7%95%D7%94-%D7%97	Chanukah	Can I talk while I'm lighting?	Once the first light is lit, try not to talk about other things until you finish. Talking about the lighting, like asking for oil or a match, is fine.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 676:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%95B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94-%D7%97
2026-12-09	כ״ט כסלו תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	When do I say Hanerot Halalu?	After you've lit the first light and taken your hand away, even though the others are still to be lit. Not before, so it doesn't interrupt.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 676:9	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%95B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94-%D7%98	Rosh Chodesh	Do women stop work on Rosh Chodesh?	Some women have that custom, and it's a good one, though work is allowed. Even so, they may run the washing machine, wash dishes and clean the house, married or single.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 417:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%99%d7%96-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a8%d7%90%d7%a9-%d7%97%d7%95%d7%93%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%99%D7%96B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%A9B%D7%97%D7%95%D7%93%D7%A9-%D7%90
2026-12-10	ל׳ כסלו תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	Do women say Hallel on Chanukah?	Women are exempt from Hallel on Chanukah, though they must light. If they want to say it, they may, but without the bracha.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 683:9	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%92-%d7%90%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%9c-%d7%91%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%92B-B%D7%90%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%9CB%D7%91%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%98	Chanukah	Should the family be there when I light?	Ideally, yes: gather the household for the brachot, to publicize the miracle. If you get home late and everyone is asleep, wake one or two if you can; if not, light with the brachot anyway.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 677:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%96-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%a1%d7%a0%d7%90%d7%99-%d7%95%d7%91%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%99%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%91%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%96B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%A1%D7%A0%D7%90%D7%99B%D7%95%D7%91%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%91%D7%94-%D7%90
2026-12-11	א׳ טבת תשפ״ז	Chanukah	Chanukah	How much oil do I need on Friday?	Enough to burn until half an hour after nightfall, about an hour from lighting, so light about a quarter of an hour before sunset, not earlier. If not even one light will last that long, light without a bracha.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 679, 680, נר חנוכה בערב שבת‎, §4	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%98-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%a4-%d7%a0%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%98%2CB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%A4B-B%D7%A0%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%93	Chanukah	My meal on the last day of Chanukah runs into the night. Do I say Al Hanissim?	Yes, in Birkat Hamazon, since the meal began on Chanukah. But if you davened Arvit in the middle of the meal, leave it out.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 682:12	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%91-%d7%a2%d7%9c-%d7%94%d7%a0%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%91%d7%97%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%91B-B%D7%A2%D7%9CB%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%91%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%91
2026-12-13	ג׳ טבת תשפ״ז	Year-round	Brachot	What should my first words be in the morning?	Ideally, a mitzvah. Avoid idle talk when you wake, and start with the morning brachot and Birkot HaTorah, then the rest of the prayers. Just hand them over while it's still day, so no one thinks you asked him to carry them on Shabbat. 2026-12-15	ה׳ טבת תשפ״ז	Year-round	Brachot	Which foods get Shehakol?	Anything that doesn't grow from the ground: meat, chicken, fish, eggs, milk, cheese, water and so on. If you said Ha'adama on cheese, milk or meat, you must say Shehakol. Yes, if they grew in that water, in a container or a cistern without a spring; you needn't worry if one gets in your mouth. But don't pour it into a cup to drink, and once a creature has left the water, it's forbidden. No. The bracha is "asher bema'amaro bara shechakim" alone. The custom is to say Leshem Yichud first, though it isn't required. If you are ill, pregnant or nursing, ask a rav. Count your brachot from Friday night to Shabbat evening. If you read the Haftara well, take Maftir for its brachot; leading the prayers adds the brachot of the repetition. Not if it crossed the techum: stay on the plane until Shabbat ends, or if you can't, within the airport grounds. You may hand your passport to a non-Jewish officer to stamp. You may answer Amen to brachot heard live, but you must hear the reading itself in person.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 689:16	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%98-%d7%a9%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%9c-%d7%97%d7%99%d7%99%d7%91%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%91%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%92%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%98B-B%D7%A9%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%9CB%D7%97%D7%99%D7%99%D7%91%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%91%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94-%D7%98%D7%96	Kiddush Levana	Can I say Kiddush Levana through a thin cloud?	According to the Sefardi minhag, wait for it to pass, unless you'll miss the month. Through a thick cloud, no one says it.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 426:5	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9b%d7%95-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%91%d7%a0%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%95B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%91%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%94
2027-03-17	ח׳ אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Purim	Do I stand for the Megillah brachot?	It depends on your community's custom. If you stand in shul, stand when reading at home for women too; the reading itself can be sitting.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 690:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a6-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%92%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A6B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94-%D7%91	Purim	Do I say the bracha along with the chazan on my own Megillah?	No. Answering Amen to him would then be an interruption. If you did answer Amen, don't repeat the bracha. 2027-03-18	ט׳ אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Purim	Kids are making noise at Haman's name. What should the Megillah reader do?	Wait for the noise to stop, then repeat the word, so everyone hears it properly. No. You're covered by hearing him read them. 2027-03-19	י׳ אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Purim	Which verses do we all say aloud in the Megillah?	"Ish Yehudi", "Balayla hahu", "UMordechai yatza" and "LaYehudim hayta ora"; in Jerusalem also "Ki Mordechai HaYehudi". The reader then reads each one himself.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 690:27	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a6-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%92%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A6B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94-%D7%9B%D7%96	Purim	Can I eat before hearing the Megillah?	Not a meal, so women wait until their husbands come home to read. You may taste fruit, a little bread or cake, and drink tea or coffee. 2027-03-21	י״ב אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Fast days	I woke during the night before a fast. Can I eat before dawn?	Only if you said before going to sleep that you'd get up and eat. By the Zohar, don't eat even then. No, not until the last bracha after it. If you did, you must go back to that verse and read on from there yourself; for a few words, a chumash will do if you have no kosher Megillah. 2027-03-22	י״ג אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Purim	Which brachot are said on the Megillah?	At night, three: "al mikra Megillah", "she'asa nissim" and "Shehecheyanu". By day, Shehecheyanu isn't repeated. Yes, and a married woman isn't covered by her husband's. It's better that women send to women and men to men, but where needed a man may send to a woman, especially a poor one. 2027-03-24	ט״ו אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	Purim	Purim	I live in Tel Aviv and I'm in Jerusalem on the 15th. Do I keep Purim again?	No, if you were home at dawn on the 14th and kept Purim there, you needn't hear the Megillah or give gifts again. Hearing the Megillah again on the 15th is a nice stringency.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 688, כרכים המוקפים חומה‎, §9	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%97-%d7%9b%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%a7%d7%a4%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%97%d7%95%d7%9e%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%97B-B%D7%9B%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%A7%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%97%D7%95%D7%9E%D7%94-%D7%98	Purim	Can I work on the other Purim day?	Yes. Unwalled cities may work on the 15th and walled cities on the 14th; there's no valid custom to stop work on both days. 2027-03-26	י״ז אדר ב׳ תשפ״ז	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	Can I rely on selling my chametz?	Yes. Selling chametz before Pesach is the accepted custom, and it shouldn't be questioned.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 448, מכירת חמץ‎, §1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9e%d7%97-%d7%a1%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%a3-%d7%92-%d7%9e%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%aa-%d7%97%d7%9e%d7%a5/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9E%D7%97B%D7%A1%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%A3B%D7%92%27B-B%D7%9E%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%AAB%D7%97%D7%9E%D7%A5-%D7%90	Brachot	Why make the effort to daven with a minyan?	So that you can answer "Baruch Hashem hamevorach" to Barchu. The Chida brings a passage of Rabbi Akiva about Barchu; if you say it, say it after davening, before Aleinu, not between Yishtabach and Yotzer, and say "Hashem" rather than the Divine name. 2027-04-09	ב׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Can I leave a pot in the kashering water?	Before the chametz deadline on Erev Pesach, yes; after it, take it right out. Maran even allows kashering a pot used in the last 24 hours before the deadline, though some are strict.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 452:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a0%d7%91-%d7%9e%d7%aa%d7%99-%d7%96%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%92%d7%a2%d7%9c%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%9c%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A0%D7%91B-B%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%99B%D7%96%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%92%D7%A2%D7%9C%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%9C%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%90	Birkat Ha'ilanot	What is Birkat Ha'ilanot?	In Nissan, when you see fruit trees in blossom, say "Baruch Ata… shelo chisar be'olamo klum…". It's said once a year, without Shehecheyanu.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 226:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%90%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%90%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%90
2027-04-11	ד׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	I don't eat rice on Pesach. Can I cook it for others who do?	Yes, even on Yom Tov.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 453, אורז בפסח‎, §9	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a0%d7%92-%d7%90%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%96-%d7%91%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A0%D7%92B-B%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%96B%D7%91%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%98	Pesach	Do women lean at the Seder?	Yes, women must lean too. Remind everyone, since we're not used to leaning during the year.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 472:6	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%91-%d7%aa%d7%a4-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%99%d7%a1%d7%91%d7%94-%d7%95%d7%90%d7%a8%d7%91%d7%a2-%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%a7%d7%93%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%91-%D7%AA%D7%A4B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%91%D7%94B%D7%95%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%A2B%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%A7%D7%93%D7%A9-%D7%95
2027-04-12	ה׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Who fasts on Erev Pesach?	Firstborns, of the father or the mother, recalling the saving of Israel's firstborn. Since it's a custom, a firstborn in pain, like with sore eyes, is exempt.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 470:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2B-B%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%90	Pesach	I'm a firstborn and started fasting, then found a siyum. Can I eat?	Yes, even at home afterward, and you needn't make up the fast.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 470:17	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2B-B%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%99%D7%96
2027-04-13	ו׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Can I work on Erev Pesach afternoon?	Only what's allowed on Chol HaMoed, like preventing a loss or simple work for the festival. Business is allowed, but it's good to stop by Mincha Ketana.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 468:4	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a1%d7%97-%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A1%D7%97B-B%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%93	Pesach	Can I say "this meat is for Pesach"?	No, it sounds like a Korban Pesach; say "for Yom Tov". It's good to say this about chicken and fish too, but "this wheat is for Pesach" is fine.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 469:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a1%d7%98-%d7%90%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%a8-%d7%96%d7%94-%d7%9c%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A1%D7%98B-B%D7%90%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8B%D7%96%D7%94B%D7%9C%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%90
2027-04-14	ז׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Can women drink grape juice for the four cups?	Yes, if real wine is very hard for them. For Kiddush and Havdala, grape juice is fine for anyone.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 472:26	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%91-%d7%aa%d7%a4-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%99%d7%a1%d7%91%d7%94-%d7%95%d7%90%d7%a8%d7%91%d7%a2-%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%a7%d7%93%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%91-%D7%AA%D7%A4B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%91%D7%94B%D7%95%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%A2B%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%A7%D7%93%D7%A9-%D7%9B%D7%95	Kiddush Levana	Can I start Kiddush Levana if clouds are coming?	Ideally not, if you know they'll cover the moon before you finish. Start when you expect it to stay visible.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 426:6	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9b%d7%95-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%91%d7%a0%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%95B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%91%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%95
2027-04-15	ח׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Should I avoid maror or eggs on Erev Pesach?	No. Some avoid maror that day, but that is not the Sefardi minhag. Avoiding eggs has no basis in halacha and may be dropped without hatarat nedarim.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 471:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%90-%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%90B-B%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%97	Pesach	Should children nap on Erev Pesach?	Yes, so they're fresh for the Seder. Children who understand get the four cups, grape juice is fine; it's even more important to give them nuts or sweets before the Seder. 2027-04-16	ט׳ ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Do I wash for karpas?	Yes, the way you wash for bread, but without the bracha. It's good not to talk until you've eaten the karpas.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 473, כוס ראשון ושני ורחץ‎, §1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%92-%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%a1-%d7%a8%d7%90%d7%a9%d7%95%d7%9f-%d7%95%d7%a9%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%97%d7%a5/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%92B-B%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A1B%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%95%D7%9FB%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%97%D7%A5-%D7%90	Pesach	Do daughters ask at the Seder too?	Yes. Daughters who can ask come before your wife and before guests, though make special effort to involve the sons. 2027-04-18	י״א ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	My child already asked a question. Do we still say Ma Nishtana?	Yes, all of it, unless the child asked all the questions; then you may go straight to Avadim Hayinu.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 473, מגיד‎, §12	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%92-%d7%9e%d7%92%d7%99%d7%93/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%92B-B%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%99%D7%93-%D7%99%D7%91	Pesach	I forgot to dip the korech in charoset. Do I eat it again?	No, you're covered if eating again is hard. It's still good to dip a little matza and maror and eat it leaning. 2027-04-19	י״ב ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Should we say Torah at the Seder?	Yes, and learn Mishnayot Pesachim. But if people are getting sleepy, hurry and finish Hallel.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 477:14	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a2%d7%96-%d7%a6%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%9f/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A2%D7%96B-B%D7%A6%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%9F-%D7%99%D7%93	Pesach	Until when can we eat the afikoman?	Make sure to eat it before midnight (chatzot). After the fact, it still counts after midnight. 2027-04-20	י״ג ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	When do we search for chametz?	On the night of 14 Nissan, right after nightfall, about 20 minutes after sunset. If you searched after sunset but before nightfall, it counts, but search a little more after nightfall without a bracha.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 431:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9c%d7%90-%d7%96%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%91%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%97%d7%9e%d7%a5/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9C%D7%90B-B%D7%96%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%91%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%97%D7%9E%D7%A5-%D7%91	Pesach	Someone else searches for chametz for me. Who says the bracha?	The one searching, if you don't search at all yourself. 2027-04-21	י״ד ניסן תשפ״ז	Pesach preparation	Pesach	When must I burn the chametz?	Burn it and say bitul before the sixth hour begins. Once burning time comes, don't start any work until it's done.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 445:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9e%d7%94-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%a2%d7%95%d7%a8-%d7%97%d7%9e%d7%a5/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9E%D7%94B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%91%D7%99%D7%A2%D7%95%D7%A8B%D7%97%D7%9E%D7%A5-%D7%91	Pesach	Can I say bitul chametz in Hebrew without understanding it?	No. It only works if you understand it, so say it in your own language. 2027-04-23	ט״ז ניסן תשפ״ז	Chol HaMoed Pesach	Chol HaMoed	Can I get a haircut on Chol HaMoed?	No, not even if you were prevented before Yom Tov. Yes: set the table, make the beds and tidy up, ideally close to evening so it's clearly for Shabbat, and leave the table set all Shabbat. 2027-10-13	י״ב תשרי תשפ״ח	Sukkot is coming	Sukkah	On the first night of Sukkot, how quickly must I eat the kezayit of bread in the sukka? Yalkut Yosef, OC 689:15	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a4%d7%98-%d7%a9%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%9c-%d7%97%d7%99%d7%99%d7%91%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%91%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%92%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%98B-B%D7%A9%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%9CB%D7%97%D7%99%D7%99%D7%91%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%91%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94-%D7%98%D7%95	Brachot	I ate bread that was kneaded with milk. Do I bentch?	Some say no, when it looks like ordinary bread. The Sages forbade bread kneaded with milk or meat fat unless it has a distinctive shape, so it is treated like forbidden food: no bentching and no zimun. Bread with a distinctive shape is permitted, and you bentch as usual.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 196:3	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a7%d7%a6%d7%95-%d7%9e%d7%99-%d7%a9%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%9c-%d7%90%d7%99%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%a8-%d7%90%d7%9d-%d7%9e%d7%a6%d7%98%d7%a8%d7%a3-%d7%9c%d7%96%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%9f/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A7%D7%A6%D7%95B-B%D7%9E%D7%99B%D7%A9%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%9CB%D7%90%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%A8B%D7%90%D7%9DB%D7%9E%D7%A6%D7%98%D7%A8%D7%A3B%D7%9C%D7%96%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%9F-%D7%92

2028-08-01	ט׳ אב תשפ״ח	The Nine Days	Tisha B'Av	Do we wear tallit and tefillin at Shacharit on Tisha B'Av?	The Jerusalem custom is to daven Shacharit with the congregation in tallit and tefillin, and those who adopt it do well. Where they're worn only at Mincha, put them on at home before Shacharit and say Shema in them, after Birkot HaTorah, then take them off and go to shul. In the bracha Boneh Yerushalayim; according to the Jerusalem custom, at Arvit, Shacharit and Mincha. If you forgot, add it in Shema Koleinu, or in Retzei, or after Elokai Netzor; you don't repeat the Amida for it. Should I light there?	No need, since nowadays no one will suspect you, and the household knows you're covered by your host's lighting. 2028-12-11	כ״ג כסלו תשפ״ט	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	On Shabbat Chanukah we eat at my parents' but sleep at home. Where do we light the menorah?	Some say at home: light the Chanukah lights after plag haMincha before you leave, with enough oil to burn until half an hour after nightfall, since you'll be sleeping at home. No, light it where it's going to stand. If it's already standing there, even if it wasn't put there for the mitzva, you needn't lift it and put it back; just light it in place. There's good reason to allow it, since you surely never meant the drips for the mitzva. Not while it could still be used for lighting. Only a very small amount, of the kind people normally pour away, may be thrown out. 2028-12-13	כ״ה כסלו תשפ״ט	Chanukah	Chanukah	The candle I was lighting with went out. Can I relight it from a Chanukah light?	No, don't light from one Chanukah light to another through a separate candle. You may light a Chanukah light directly from the one beside it with a long wick, even an extra light from the main one, since both are mitzva lights. Yalkut Yosef, OC 676:10	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%94%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A2%D7%95B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%94%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%94-%D7%99	Shabbat	My jumper gives off little sparks when I pull it off. 2028-12-21	ג׳ טבת תשפ״ט	Year-round	Shabbat	Must I eat meat on Shabbat? 2029-01-03	ט״ז טבת תשפ״ט	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I read the newspaper on Shabbat?	Ideally not, especially someone devoted to Torah study. 2029-01-25	ט׳ שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Brachot on fruit	What's the bracha on pine nuts?	Shehakol, since they grow on a tree that isn't a fruit tree. Yalkut Yosef, OC 203:11	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%92-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%aa-%d7%a4%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%90%d7%a8%d7%a5/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%92B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AAB%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A5-%D7%99%D7%90	Women	Which grandfather should be sandak?	Some honour the husband's father at the first son and the wife's father at the second. If the husband's father gives up his turn, the wife's father can be sandak at the first son. If a grandfather and great-grandfather both want it, the baby's grandfather comes first.	Yalkut Yosef, YD 240, כיבוד בסנדקאות וקריאת שם לילדים‎, §1	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%9e-%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%91%d7%95%d7%93-%d7%91%d7%a1%d7%a0%d7%93%d7%a7%d7%90%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%a9%d7%9d-%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%93%d7%99/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%9EB-B%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%91%D7%95%D7%93B%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A0%D7%93%D7%A7%D7%90%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%A9%D7%9DB%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%90
2029-01-26	י׳ שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Brachot on fruit	What's the bracha on cashews?	Ha'etz. Cashew trees were once grown mainly for their sour fruit, so the nut was Ha'adama, but today they're grown for the nut too.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 204:17	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%93-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%a2%d7%9c-%d7%99%d7%aa%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%93B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%A2%D7%9CB%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%99%D7%96	Brachot on fruit	I made a bracha on food, then remembered it's a public fast day. Should I taste it?	On a public fast such as 10 Tevet, yes, taste a little so the bracha isn't wasted; the same applies if you forgot it was before Shacharit, before Kiddush or Havdala, or within six hours of eating meat. But if you discover the food itself is forbidden, don't taste it. 2029-01-28	י״ב שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Brachot on fruit	I said Al ha'etz after an apple by mistake. Am I covered?	Yes, after the fact you're covered for an apple or any tree fruit not of the seven species, and you don't say Borei Nefashot. Shehakol. If you said Ha'adama, you're covered. 2029-01-29	י״ג שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Tu Bishvat	What's the bracha on wine that's mostly water?	According to the Sefardi ruling it's Shehakol, and it can't be used for Kiddush, though a Sefardi who hears Kiddush from an Ashkenazi using such wine has fulfilled it. So don't rely on every wine's hechsher without checking that it requires mostly wine.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 204:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%93-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%a2%d7%9c-%d7%99%d7%aa%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%93B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%A2%D7%9CB%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%97	Tu Bishvat	I need to say both Asher Yatzar and Borei Nefashot. Which comes first?	Asher Yatzar first, then Borei Nefashot. After cake, say Al hamichya first, then Asher Yatzar; after a bread meal, bentch first, unless you're afraid you'll then forget Asher Yatzar. 2029-01-30	י״ד שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Brachot on fruit	I ate half a kezayit of apple and half of orange. Do I say Borei Nefashot?	Yes, different fruits, like apple and orange or watermelon and melon, combine to make up the amount for Borei Nefashot. But half a kezayit of cake and half of rice don't combine.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 208:6	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%97-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%9c%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%97B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%A9-%D7%95	Tu Bishvat	I said Hagefen on grapes by mistake. Am I covered?	Yes, and the same applies if you said Al hagefen after eating grapes. 2029-01-31	ט״ו שבט תשפ״ט	Tu Bishvat: brachot on fruit	Brachot on fruit	I made Hagefen on wine and now want grapes. Do they need a bracha?	Yes, say Ha'etz on the grapes. Afterwards, combine them in one after-bracha: 'al hagefen ve'al pri hagefen ve'al ha'etz ve'al pri ha'etz'.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 208:34	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%97-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%9c%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%97B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%A9-%D7%9C%D7%93	Tu Bishvat	I'm not sure whether I said the after-bracha on fruit. What now?	Don't say it out of doubt; only Birkat HaMazon is repeated when unsure. If you can, eat another kezayit within the usual time and then say it; if not, leave it. 2029-02-01	ט״ז שבט תשפ״ט	Year-round	Shabbat	My chamin is drying out on Shabbat. Can I pour in hot water from the kettle?	No, even water kept hot since before Shabbat, since it cools a little as it's poured and reheats in the pot. Instead, take the pot off, put an empty pot on the heat and set the chamin on top, without putting it down on the ground in between.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 318, בישול אחר אפייה וקליה‎, §70	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%97-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%a9%d7%95%d7%9c-%d7%90%d7%97%d7%a8-%d7%90%d7%a4%d7%99%d7%99%d7%94-%d7%95%d7%a7%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%97B-B%D7%91%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%95%D7%9CB%D7%90%D7%97%D7%A8B%D7%90%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%99%D7%94B%D7%95%D7%A7%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%A2	Women	I baked small batches in separate pans and froze them. Do they combine for challah?	Some say a freezer doesn't combine them, and likewise a modern oven or closed cupboards; others disagree. So when you take challah, put the cakes together in a basket or cover them with a cloth, and then it works according to everyone. 2029-02-02	י״ז שבט תשפ״ט	Erev Shabbat	Erev Shabbat	Can I put water under the oil in my Shabbat glasses?	Yes, before Shabbat, to raise the oil, even though the flame will go out when it reaches the water. But don't add water in order to make it go out; that's forbidden even before Shabbat.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 265:3	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%a1%d7%94-%d7%9b%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%aa%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%aa%d7%97%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%a0%d7%a8/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%A1%D7%94B-B%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%A8-%D7%92	Brachot	I drank the wine from the bentching cup and now want coffee. Do I say Shehakol?	No. Don't say Al hagefen on the wine before the coffee, and don't say Shehakol on the coffee. But if you already said Al hagefen, or didn't drink from the bentching cup, say Shehakol on the coffee. 2029-02-04	י״ט שבט תשפ״ט	Year-round	Shabbat	I leaned on the light switch by accident on Shabbat. Can I use the light?	There's a dispute, but the ruling is that if you leaned on it without noticing and have no other room to read in, you may use the light. This doesn't apply if you flicked it on by mistake out of weekday habit.	Yalkut Yosef, דין הנאה מחשמל המיוצר בשבת‎, §29	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%a0%d7%90%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%97%d7%a9%d7%9e%d7%9c-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%95%d7%a6%d7%a8-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%90%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A9%D7%9E%D7%9CB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%95%D7%A6%D7%A8B%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%9B%D7%98	Tefilla & shul	Can I bow at other brachot of the Amida as well?	No. Bow only at the start and end of Avot and of Modim; bowing at the start or end of other brachot looks arrogant. But you may bow in the middle of a bracha or between brachot, and it's fitting to when you hear the chazzan say Modim. 2029-02-05	כ׳ שבט תשפ״ט	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I book a taxi before Shabbat to pick me up as soon as Shabbat ends?	Yes, if you need to, you may book it before Shabbat from a non-Jewish taxi company to come right after Shabbat.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 307, דין אמירה לגוי בשבת‎, §14	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%96-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%90%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%94-%d7%9c%d7%92%d7%95%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%96B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%90%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%94B%D7%9C%D7%92%D7%95%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%99%D7%93	Between people	My father is Yosef and my friend is Yosef Chaim. Can I say my friend's name around him?	Yes, a double name counts as a different name, and so does adding the surname. But if your father's name is unusual, the name itself must differ, and it must be clear you don't mean your father.	Yalkut Yosef, YD 240, דין מורא מאב ואם‎, §64	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%9e-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%90-%d7%9e%d7%90%d7%91-%d7%95%d7%90%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%9EB-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%90B%D7%9E%D7%90%D7%91B%D7%95%D7%90%D7%9D-%D7%A1%D7%93
2029-02-06	כ״א שבט תשפ״ט	Year-round	Brachot	I only ate a small bite of bread with my meal. Does Hamotzi cover the rest?	No. A meal counts as a bread meal only if you eat at least a kezayit of bread; with less, say brachot on the cooked food you eat after it. 2029-02-19	ד׳ אדר תשפ״ט	Adar: Purim is coming	Purim	Can I send meat to a Sefardi friend as mishloach manot?	Only Beit Yosef (chalak) meat counts; ordinary kosher meat doesn't fulfil the mitzva for a Sefardi, since we follow Maran, who forbids it. Sending ordinary kosher meat to an Ashkenazi friend may count, and even if he's strict like Maran, he can give it to his young children. 2029-02-27	י״ב אדר תשפ״ט	Purim	Fast days	Do I wear tefillin at Mincha on a fast day?	No. The custom in Israel is to wear them only at Shacharit on public fasts; some once wore them at Mincha too, but that isn't seen in Israel today. 2029-03-04	י״ז אדר תשפ״ט	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	Can I take my regular medication on Pesach?	Yes. Most pills today contain no chametz, so if you're unwell, never stop medication your doctor prescribed. A pill that does contain chametz is allowed only for real illness, not a mere ache, if it's bitter and swallowed whole; tasty lozenges you suck are allowed only if made from corn or potato starch. Can I skip it?	No. You must still daven Arvit; not being able to concentrate doesn't exempt you. Make every effort to concentrate at least in the first bracha (Avot) or in Modim. 2029-03-12	כ״ה אדר תשפ״ט	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	Can I sell my neighbour's chametz for him without telling him?	Ideally no; sell someone's chametz only with his permission. Should I tell them?	No, even though it upsets you for their sake; passing it on is tale-bearing. Only do so if it serves a purpose, such as so your father can ask that person to stop. 2029-03-13	כ״ו אדר תשפ״ט	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	I live in Israel but have chametz in America. By when must it be sold?	Ideally, have it sold while it's still before the deadline in Israel too. After the fact, if it was sold before the American deadline but after Israel's, the chametz is permitted after Pesach. 2029-03-14	כ״ז אדר תשפ״ט	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	How do I kasher my barbecue grill and skewers for Pesach?	If chametz is sometimes put on them, they need libun, heating in fire until sparks fly; boiling (hag'ala) isn't enough to start with, though food made after boiling them is permitted after the fact. If you don't know that chametz was ever used on them, boiling is enough. After Elokai Netzor, before 'Yihyu leratzon', the custom is to say a verse from Tanach that begins with the first letter of your name and ends with its last letter. 2029-03-15	כ״ח אדר תשפ״ט	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	Our Seder matza was baked well before Pesach. Is that all right?	Yes. Ideally the custom is to bake the Seder matza on Erev Pesach afternoon, but after the fact, matza baked even days before Pesach fulfils the mitzva.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 458:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a0%d7%97-%d7%90%d7%a4%d7%99%d7%99%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a4%d7%a1%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A0%D7%97B-B%D7%90%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%99%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A4%D7%A1%D7%97-%D7%90	Women	Can we hold our chuppa in a shul?	In Israel there's no objection in principle, as long as the shul's holiness is kept: women enter modestly with hair covered and sit fully separate, with no idle talk, eating, drinking or smoking. Where these conditions aren't kept, it shouldn't be allowed; it's up to the community's rabbis. 2029-03-16	כ״ט אדר תשפ״ט	Rosh Chodesh Nissan	Pesach	Can I buy Pesach food in a shop that also sells non-kosher?	Not food that relies on the shopkeeper's word, since someone who sells forbidden food can't be trusted on Pesach kashrut. Sealed cans or packets with a recognized hechsher are fine. 2029-03-18	ב׳ ניסן תשפ״ט	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Do we say Tachanun in Nissan?	No, not for the whole month: no Viduy, Tachanun or falling on the face. All of Nissan is a time of joy for Israel, beginning with the dedication of the Mishkan on the first of Nissan. Yes, a private fast is allowed in Nissan, except on Rosh Chodesh Nissan and the seven days of Pesach, and it's better not to fast on the day after Pesach either. 2029-03-20	ד׳ ניסן תשפ״ט	Pesach preparation	Pesach	I got home exhausted from a work trip on the night of the chametz search. Can I nap first?	Yes, a short nap early in the evening, if you're too tired to search properly. Ask someone at home to wake you after about half an hour; a coffee is fine too. Later at night, when people usually go to bed, asking to be woken isn't enough. Yes. A pot indoors under a roof may be sown and watered as usual, even if it has a drainage hole. Sowing in a pot is only forbidden when it stands under the open sky. 2029-03-23	ז׳ ניסן תשפ״ט	Pesach preparation	Pesach	A Yom Tov shirt tore on Erev Pesach afternoon. Can I sew it?	Yes. No, if there's no town rav whose eruv covers you, or you neglected it, you may not bake or cook for Shabbat. If you remember during the day, count then without a bracha, and from that night carry on counting with a bracha, even if this happens more than once. No. If you asked her to wash the dishes, which she could do by hand, and she uses the electric dishwasher to make it easier for herself, you needn't object, since that's her own choice. Passengers on a plane or train may make a minyan, even with high seats between them, gathering in one place to hear the chazzan. The custom in Israel is to blow tashrat, tashat and tarat for each of Malchuyot, Zichronot and Shofarot. Maran describes a different custom, but this one changed for the better and shouldn't be altered. 2029-09-12	ג׳ תשרי תש״צ	Aseret Yemei Teshuva	Fast days	When does a minor fast start and end?	It starts at dawn, 72 seasonal minutes before sunrise, and ends at nightfall, about 20 minutes after sunset. Unlike Tisha B'Av, it doesn't begin the evening before. Yalkut Yosef, OC 607:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%96-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%95%d7%99%d7%93%d7%95%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%9e%d7%a0%d7%97%d7%94-%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%96B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%95%D7%99%D7%93%D7%95%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%A0%D7%97%D7%94B%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91	Yom Kippur	What should we eat on Erev Yom Kippur?	Light, easily digested food, so you don't daven overfull and proud. Avoid foods that heat the body, like eggs, garlic, fatty meat and spiced dishes; some add dates. Hot milk is avoided too, but at the morning meal it's fine, especially in coffee or tea. 2029-11-15	ח׳ כסלו תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I read the greeting cards we received on Shabbat?	No. Personal letters and greeting cards, such as New Year cards, shouldn't be read on Shabbat, since the Sages feared it would lead to reading business papers. No. As with every mitzva, the brachot aren't essential, so you've done the mitzva, and you may not put the lights out to relight them with a bracha. 2030-01-31	כ״ז שבט תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I sweep the floor on Shabbat?	Yes, Sefardim, who follow Maran, may sweep a tiled floor with a broom as on a weekday, even if some stiff bristles break off. An untiled floor may only be swept by a non-Jew.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 337, דין כיבוד וניקוי הבית‎, §1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%9c%d7%96-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%91%d7%95%d7%93-%d7%95%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%a7%d7%95%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%91%d7%99%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%96B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%91%D7%95%D7%93B%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%91%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%90	Women	My parents object to the person I want to marry just because of their community or family. Must I listen?	No. If it's clear the person is God-fearing with good character, honouring parents doesn't require you to give them up. Go about it calmly and with a rav's advice.	Yalkut Yosef, YD 240, באיזה אופנים אין חיוב לשמוע לאביו‎, §18	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%9e-%d7%91%d7%90%d7%99%d7%96%d7%94-%d7%90%d7%95%d7%a4%d7%a0%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%90%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%97%d7%99%d7%95%d7%91-%d7%9c%d7%a9%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%a2-%d7%9c%d7%90/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%9EB-B%D7%91%D7%90%D7%99%D7%96%D7%94B%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%90%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%97%D7%99%D7%95%D7%91B%D7%9C%D7%A9%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%A2B%D7%9C%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95-%D7%99%D7%97
2030-02-01	כ״ח שבט תש״צ	Rosh Chodesh Adar 1	Erev Shabbat	I made Kiddush and the wine turned out to be vinegar. What now?	Make Kiddush again on other wine, repeating both Hagefen and the Kiddush bracha. That's only if it's really vinegar, the kind that fizzes when poured on the ground; otherwise don't repeat it.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 272:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%a2%d7%91-%d7%a2%d7%9c-%d7%90%d7%99%d7%96%d7%94-%d7%99%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%9e%d7%a7%d7%93%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%A2%27%27%D7%91B-B%D7%A2%D7%9CB%D7%90%D7%99%D7%96%D7%94B%D7%99%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%9E%D7%A7%D7%93%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91	Rosh Chodesh	On Rosh Chodesh I said 'Lo lanu' or 'Ahavti' in Hallel by mistake. Do I repeat?	No. It isn't an interruption, since they're part of Hallel on the days it's said in full, so you don't need to say Hallel again.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 422:9	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/13/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%9b%d7%91-%d7%a7%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%90%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%9c-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%90%d7%a9-%d7%97%d7%95%d7%93%d7%a9/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%91B-B%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%90%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%9CB%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%A9B%D7%97%D7%95%D7%93%D7%A9-%D7%98
2030-02-03	ל׳ שבט תש״צ	Year-round	Brachot	Can people who didn't eat bread help make a zimun of ten?	Yes, as long as at least seven of the ten ate bread; up to three may have eaten other food, such as vegetables. With only six bread-eaters, they don't join.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 196:5	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a7%d7%a6%d7%95-%d7%9e%d7%99-%d7%a9%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%9c-%d7%90%d7%99%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%a8-%d7%90%d7%9d-%d7%9e%d7%a6%d7%98%d7%a8%d7%a3-%d7%9c%d7%96%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%9f/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A7%D7%A6%D7%95B-B%D7%9E%D7%99B%D7%A9%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%9CB%D7%90%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%A8B%D7%90%D7%9DB%D7%9E%D7%A6%D7%98%D7%A8%D7%A3B%D7%9C%D7%96%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%9F-%D7%94	Tefilla & shul	I'm the sandak at a brit and wearing a tallit. Do I say the bracha?	Yes. The sandak and the baby's father who wear a tallit gadol at the brit say the bracha and wrap themselves in it, just as at Shacharit.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 18:11	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%99%d7%97-%d7%96%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a6%d7%99%d7%a6%d7%99%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%99%D7%97B-B%D7%96%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A6%D7%99%D7%A6%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%99%D7%90
2030-02-04	א׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	I'm called up for reserve duty on Shabbat. Can I carry my weapon?	Not in a public area, unless there's a security reason and possible danger to life.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 301, דיני הוצאה בשבת‎, §50	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%90-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%95%d7%a6%d7%90%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%90B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%95%D7%A6%D7%90%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%A0	Between people	I've arrived after a trip. Should I call my parents?	Yes, if they'll be worried, it's a mitzva to let them know you've arrived, even after just an evening out. Before going abroad for a while, it's right to say goodbye in person, kiss their hands and ask for their bracha.	Yalkut Yosef, YD 240, דין מורא מאב ואם‎, §47	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%9e-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%9e%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%90-%d7%9e%d7%90%d7%91-%d7%95%d7%90%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%9EB-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%90B%D7%9E%D7%90%D7%91B%D7%95%D7%90%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%96
2030-02-05	ב׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Brachot	The shul is saying the 13 Middot while I'm in Pesukei DeZimra. Do I join?	No, don't stop, since they're a prayer and not part of the praises.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 51:11	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a0%d7%90-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%aa%d7%a4%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%9a-%d7%a9%d7%90%d7%9e%d7%a8-%d7%a2%d7%93-%d7%99%d7%a9%d7%aa%d7%91%d7%97/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A0%D7%90B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%AA%D7%A4%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%9AB%D7%A9%D7%90%D7%9E%D7%A8B%D7%A2%D7%93B%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%AA%D7%91%D7%97-%D7%99%D7%90	Home & kashrut	I wear dentures. Can I just clean them instead of waiting six hours after meat?	No, you must wait the six hours; changing or carefully cleaning the dentures doesn't help. After six hours you may eat dairy with the same dentures without kashering them, but if meat may be stuck in gaps, clean them well first.	Yalkut Yosef, YD 89:12	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a4%d7%98-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%aa-%d7%92%d7%91%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%94-%d7%90%d7%97%d7%a8-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%a8/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A4%D7%98B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%AAB%D7%92%D7%91%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%94B%D7%90%D7%97%D7%A8B%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8-%D7%99%D7%91
2030-02-06	ג׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I peel apples or cucumbers now for Seuda Shlishit?	Yes, peel attached to the fruit, as on apples, pears and cucumbers, isn't sorting, so you may peel them even for the last meal before Shabbat ends. Don't peel them for after Shabbat.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 319, ברירה בפירות וירקות‎, §61	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%98-%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a4%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%95%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%a7%d7%95%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%98B-B%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%95%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%A1%D7%90	Tefilla & shul	Should I learn Torah while I'm driving?	It's good to be busy with Torah on a journey, but the driver shouldn't get into deep halachic analysis, since the distraction can lead to danger. Passengers may learn in depth as much as they can. 2030-02-07	ד׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	Can I hang washing in the bathroom on Shabbat where nobody sees?	No. Hanging washing is forbidden on Shabbat even in private, like over the bath, since what the Rabbis forbade because of appearances is forbidden even behind closed doors.	Yalkut Yosef, לשטוח בגד רטוב בשבת‎, §90	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/09/%d7%9c%d7%a9%d7%98%d7%95%d7%97-%d7%91%d7%92%d7%93-%d7%a8%d7%98%d7%95%d7%91-%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%9C%D7%A9%D7%98%D7%95%D7%97B%D7%91%D7%92%D7%93B%D7%A8%D7%98%D7%95%D7%91B%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%A6	Women	I'm taking pills to help me conceive. Can I take them on Shabbat?	Yes, a woman who needs to take pills for several days in order to conceive may take them on Shabbat too, especially if she started before Shabbat. 2030-02-08	ה׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Erev Shabbat	Erev Shabbat	My oven heats up as soon as the door is opened. Can I leave Shabbat food in it?	No. Don't leave food before Shabbat in an electric oven whose heating comes on as soon as the door is opened, since you won't be able to open it on Shabbat.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 253:7	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a8%d7%a0%d7%92-%d7%a9%d7%94%d7%99%d7%99%d7%aa-%d7%aa%d7%91%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%9c-%d7%a2%d7%9c-%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%a8%d7%94-%d7%9e%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%a9%d7%91%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%92B-B%D7%A9%D7%94%D7%99%D7%99%D7%AAB%D7%AA%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%9CB%D7%A2%D7%9CB%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%94B%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%AA-%D7%96	Brachot	I ate cake together with meat and other food. Does it add up to a bread meal?	No. Only the cake itself counts toward the amount that makes it a meal (about 216 grams); other foods eaten with it don't combine. 2030-02-10	ז׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	A car alarm is going off on Shabbat. Can I get it stopped?	Yes, if a car or shop alarm is faulty and keeps sounding, you may ask a non-Jew to switch it off, and even show him the hidden switch. Can I do it before Shacharit?	Yes. Food and drink taken as medicine are allowed before davening, even if you aren't seriously ill. Someone very hungry or thirsty who can't concentrate may also eat first, provided the hunger really is what stops him concentrating. 2030-02-11	ח׳ אדר א׳ תש״צ	Year-round	Shabbat	I have a bad cold and can't breathe. Can I sniff Vicks on Shabbat?	Yes, if it's hard to breathe through your nose, since it mainly opens the airways for a while rather than healing. No. You must hear it from someone who's obligated in the mitzva, so a boy under bar mitzva can't read it for others, even if he's old enough to be trained in mitzvot. No. Even though women's festival joy comes through nice clothes, mishloach manot must be food and drink for the Purim meal, which women are obligated in too. 2030-03-10	ה׳ אדר ב׳ תש״צ	Adar: Purim is coming	Purim	Can my husband and I send one mishloach manot together?	Yes. No. Don't frighten a small child with scary things, like saying a cat or dog will take him, because words can come true. 2030-03-13	ח׳ אדר ב׳ תש״צ	Purim	Purim	My city reads the Megillah on both days. Do I keep the Purim mitzvot on the 15th too?	Do them on the 14th, and it's good to be strict and do them on the 15th too: at least two portions to one person, a gift each to two poor people, and a nice meal. 2030-03-27	כ״ב אדר ב׳ תש״צ	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	I found a whole, uncracked wheat grain in my food on Pesach. What now?	Burn the grain, but the food is permitted, as long as there's 60 times as much food as the grain. If the grain got lost and you don't know whether it was cracked, the food is also permitted. Ashkenazim are strict even when the grain isn't cracked. 2030-03-28	כ״ג אדר ב׳ תש״צ	30 days before Pesach	Pesach	My family doesn't eat chicken on Pesach. Can I drop the custom?	Yes. 2030-04-10	ז׳ ניסן תש״צ	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Our baby is a firstborn son. Must one of us fast for him on Erev Pesach?	Some have the custom that the father fasts for him, or the mother if the father is himself a firstborn. In practice that parent should try to hear a siyum and eat a kezayit at its meal. Yes, a small child who doesn't yet understand the story of leaving Egypt may be given ordinary matza on Erev Pesach. 2030-04-14	י״א ניסן תש״צ	Pesach preparation	Pesach	Which vegetable do we use for karpas? 2030-04-16	י״ג ניסן תש״צ	Pesach preparation	Pesach	How do we spill the wine for the plagues?	The custom is to pour a little from the cup itself into a broken vessel at 'dam va'esh vetimrot ashan', at each plague and at 'detzach adash be'achav', sixteen times in all. Yes, if you can't take the days from your annual leave and might be fired for not coming. Risking your livelihood counts as a real loss. 2030-05-05	ב׳ אייר תש״צ	Sefirat HaOmer	Brachot	I commute to another city every day. Do I say HaGomel daily? 2030-08-05	ו׳ אב תש״צ	The Nine Days	Tisha B'Av	After the last meal I said out loud that I'm starting the fast. Can I still eat before sunset?	No. Once you've explicitly accepted the fast in words, you may not eat any more, even though it's still day. Just deciding it in your heart doesn't count as accepting it. Can I say "Abba's right"?	Not in front of him, since it implies your view settles the matter. When he isn't there you may say so. And you may answer the other side's arguments even in his presence, since that honours him. 2030-08-06	ז׳ אב תש״צ	The Nine Days	Tisha B'Av	Can I smoke on Tisha B'Av?	It's right to be strict and not smoke, especially during Eicha and Kinot in shul. A heavy smoker who suffers badly without it may smoke privately, at home, but not in public. No. Wearing shoes is forbidden the whole day, until nightfall at the end of Tisha B'Av; the Geonim were very firm about this. Is a shower enough?	Yes. If you're too weak or it's hard for you, pour nine kav of water (about 12.5 litres) over yourself instead. Hot water is fine, and you can do it in the shower.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 606, טבילה בערב יום הכפורים‎, §2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%95-%d7%a1%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%a3-%d7%93-%d7%98%d7%91%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%95B%D7%A1%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%A3B%D7%93%27B-B%D7%98%D7%91%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91
2030-10-02	ה׳ תשרי תשצ״א	Aseret Yemei Teshuva	Yom Kippur	Can I confess again sins I already confessed last Yom Kippur?	Yes, even if you haven't repeated them since, you may confess them again.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 607:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%96-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%94%d7%95%d7%99%d7%93%d7%95%d7%99-%d7%91%d7%9e%d7%a0%d7%97%d7%94-%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%96B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%94%D7%95%D7%99%D7%93%D7%95%D7%99B%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%A0%D7%97%D7%94B%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%97	Yom Kippur	Do I say the bracha before or after lighting Yom Kippur candles?	Before lighting; that's the custom. Saying it after lighting risks a bracha in vain according to most poskim and Maran. Ashkenazi women light first and then say the bracha, as they do on Shabbat.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 610:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99B-B%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91
2030-10-03	ו׳ תשרי תשצ״א	Aseret Yemei Teshuva	Yom Kippur	Should I wear nice clothes on Yom Kippur, even though it's a fast?	Yes, it's a mitzvah to wear nice, clean clothes. Since the day is honoured without food or drink, it's honoured with clean clothing.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 610:6	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%93%d7%9c%d7%a7%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%91%d7%a2%d7%a8%d7%91-%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99B-B%D7%94%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%91%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91B%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%95	Yom Kippur	I forgot and made a bracha on food on Yom Kippur. What now?	Don't taste it; say "Baruch shem kevod malchuto le'olam va'ed" instead. On other fast days it's different: if you forgot and made a bracha on food or drink, taste a little so the bracha isn't in vain.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 612:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%91-%d7%90%d7%99%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%a8-%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%91B-B%D7%90%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%A8B%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91
2030-10-04	ז׳ תשרי תשצ״א	Aseret Yemei Teshuva	Yom Kippur	Do my small children need non-leather shoes on Yom Kippur?	Ideally yes: train them to wear cloth or rubber shoes even though they eat, and it's good to buy them a pair for Yom Kippur. If they have none, you may put leather shoes on them, especially in cool weather when going barefoot could give them a chill, or if there's broken glass about.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 614, דין נעילת הסנדל ביוהכ"פ‎, §9	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%93-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%a0%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%a1%d7%a0%d7%93%d7%9c-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%95%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%93B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%A0%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%A1%D7%A0%D7%93%D7%9CB%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%94%D7%9B%27%27%D7%A4-%D7%98	Yom Kippur	The doctor says I must eat on Yom Kippur, but I feel I can fast. What do I do?	Eat. If a doctor says fasting could make your illness worse and dangerous, you must eat and drink in small amounts, even if you feel you don't need to. Fasting then isn't piety at all, and even a doubt of danger overrides the fast.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 618:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%97-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%97%d7%95%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%97B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%97%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%90
2030-10-06	ט׳ תשרי תשצ״א	Aseret Yemei Teshuva	Yom Kippur	I've been allowed to eat on Yom Kippur. Should I get an IV drip so I can fast?	No. Poskim don't advise it; instead you eat small amounts at a time. Don't look for clever ways around the halacha, especially since a drip means needlessly wounding yourself.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 618:8	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%97-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%97%d7%95%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%a4%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%97B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%97%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%94%D7%9B%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%97	Yom Kippur	I was so weak that I fell asleep and missed Ne'ila. Can I make it up?	No. Once you wake at night after its time has passed, Ne'ila has no make-up prayer.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 623:13	https://www.yalkut.info/2019/01/31/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%92-%d7%a1%d7%93%d7%a8-%d7%aa%d7%a4%d7%9c%d7%aa-%d7%a0%d7%a2%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94-2/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%92B-B%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%A8B%D7%AA%D7%A4%D7%9C%D7%AAB%D7%A0%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%92
2030-10-08	י״א תשרי תשצ״א	Sukkot is coming	Sukkah	My sukka has a metal frame. Can the schach rest directly on it?	Ideally no. Lay wooden beams or thin wooden slats across the metal pipes and put the schach on those. After the fact, schach resting straight on the metal is still kosher.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 629:29	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%98-%d7%9e%d7%9e%d7%94-%d7%a6%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9a-%d7%9c%d7%94%d7%99%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%a1%d7%9b%d7%9a/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%98B-B%D7%9E%D7%9E%D7%94B%D7%A6%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9AB%D7%9C%D7%94%D7%99%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%A1%D7%9B%D7%9A-%D7%9B%D7%98	Tefilla & shul	I made a mistake and must repeat the Amida. Can I start again right away?	No. First take your three steps back and say 'Oseh shalom' and 'Yehi ratzon', then wait the time it takes to walk four amot (about two metres) before starting again. Wait even if you plan to daven again where your steps ended.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 105:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2020/07/12/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%a7%d7%94-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%9e%d7%aa%d7%a4%d7%9c%d7%9c-%d7%91-%d7%aa%d7%a4%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%aa/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%A7%D7%94B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%A4%D7%9C%D7%9CB%D7%91%27B%D7%AA%D7%A4%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%91
2030-10-09	י״ב תשרי תשצ״א	Sukkot is coming	Sukkah	Can my balcony railing count as a sukka wall?	Yes, if its bars are less than three tefachim (about 24 cm) apart. Horizontal planks nailed with gaps of less than three tefachim also count; you don't need both upright and crosswise pieces.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 630:2	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%9c-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%93%d7%a4%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94-2/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%9CB-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%93%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%91	Lulav	I'm left-handed. Which hand do I hold the lulav in?	In your right hand, like everyone else, since here we go by everyone's right, not yours. If you did it the other way round, you've still fulfilled the mitzva.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 651:25	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a0%d7%90-%d7%a0%d7%98%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%9c%d7%91-%d7%95%d7%91%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%aa%d7%95/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%90B-B%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%AAB%D7%94%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%91B%D7%95%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%9B%D7%AA%D7%95-%D7%9B%D7%94
2030-10-10	י״ג תשרי תשצ״א	Sukkot is coming	Sukkah	Can I eat my first-night kezayit of bread with salad or fish?	It counts, but it's proper to eat that kezayit plain. Dipping the bread in hot soup or honey is fine, since that's a normal way to eat it.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 639, דיני ישיבה ואכילה בליל חג הסוכות‎, §11	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%9c%d7%98-%d7%93%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%99%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%91%d7%94-%d7%95%d7%90%d7%9b%d7%99%d7%9c%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%9c-%d7%97%d7%92-%d7%94%d7%a1/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%9C%D7%98B-B%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99B%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%91%D7%94B%D7%95%D7%90%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%9CB%D7%97%D7%92B%D7%94%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%99%D7%90	Lulav	The first day of Sukkot is on Shabbat. Why don't we take the lulav?	Since the Mikdash was destroyed, the Sages forbade taking the lulav on Shabbat, even on the first day, in case someone carries it in public to learn its bracha.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 658:7	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a0%d7%97-%d7%9e%d7%a6%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%9c%d7%91-%d7%91%d7%99%d7%95%d7%9d-%d7%98%d7%95%d7%91/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%97B-B%D7%9E%D7%A6%D7%95%D7%AAB%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%91B%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%9DB%D7%98%D7%95%D7%91-%D7%96
2030-10-11	י״ד תשרי תשצ״א	Sukkot is coming	Sukkah	When my husband says Leshev BaSukka at Kiddush, do I answer Amen?	No, say Amen only in your mind: the bracha isn't yours, and saying it aloud would interrupt between Hagefen and your drinking; Ashkenazi women may answer aloud. Likewise, if you said Shehecheyanu when lighting candles, answer his Shehecheyanu only in your heart.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 640, מי הפטורים מישיבה בסוכה‎, §4	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%9e-%d7%9e%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%a4%d7%98%d7%95%d7%a8%d7%99%d7%9d-%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%a9%d7%99%d7%91%d7%94-%d7%91%d7%a1%d7%95%d7%9b%d7%94/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%9EB-B%D7%9E%D7%99B%D7%94%D7%A4%D7%98%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9DB%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%99%D7%91%D7%94B%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%94-%D7%93	Lulav	My young son can shake a lulav. Does he need one of his own?	Yes, if you can afford it, since a father must train a child who knows how to shake. He needn't know the exact order of shaking; moving it back and forth is enough.	Yalkut Yosef, OC 657:1	https://www.yalkut.info/2014/04/24/%d7%a1%d7%99%d7%9e%d7%9f-%d7%aa%d7%a8%d7%a0%d7%96-%d7%a7%d7%98%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%99%d7%95%d7%93%d7%a2-%d7%9c%d7%a0%d7%a2%d7%a0%d7%a2-%d7%9c%d7%95%d7%9c%d7%91/#%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%9E%D7%9FB%D7%AA%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%96B-B%D7%A7%D7%98%D7%9FB%D7%94%D7%99%D7%95%D7%93%D7%A2B%D7%9C%D7%A0%D7%A2%D7%A0%D7%A2B%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%91-%D7%90
2030-10-13	ט״ז תשרי תשצ״א	Chol HaMoed Sukkot	Chol HaMoed	How should we celebrate Chol HaMoed?	As a festival: wear clean clothes, rejoice with red meat and wine, and make the women of the house happy with coloured clothes and jewellery. Ideally eat bread at both the evening and daytime meals. 2030-11-29	ג׳ כסלו תשצ״א	Erev Shabbat	Erev Shabbat	I said a whole weekday Amida on Shabbat. What now? 2030-12-20	כ״ד כסלו תשצ״א	Before Chanukah	Chanukah	I bought a new silver menorah during Chanukah. Do I say Shehecheyanu when I light it?	No. Even where a bracha is said on something new, it's at the time of buying, and you mustn't interrupt between the brachot and the lighting. Best to start using a new menorah on the first night and have it in mind when you say Shehecheyanu. Yes, the custom is to light them in shul at Shacharit each day as well, without a bracha, especially at an early minyan. No. Appoint someone to light it in its proper place, and he says the brachot, since whoever does the mitzva says the bracha. Don't say the brachot yourself while he lights. Yes, in the matching bracha: for a sick person in Refa'enu, for a livelihood in Barech Aleinu, and for a relative or friend who has left the Torah path in Hashivenu. If you forgot, ask in Shome'a Tefila; ideally ask in Hebrew, but if you can't, any language is fine. 2031-02-27	ד׳ אדר תשצ״א	Adar: Purim is coming	Purim	Does mishloach manot to my father count?	Yes. A son sending to his father, or a father to his son, fulfils the mitzva, and so does a rav sending to his student. No. The Torah obligation applies only in Israel, and only when all Jews live there, so today even in Israel it's rabbinic. That's why, in any doubt about challah, we're lenient. 2031-03-04	ט׳ אדר תשצ״א	Purim	Purim	At a big Megillah reading with a microphone, does hearing it count?	Only if you're close enough to hear the reader even without the speakers, and try to move closer so you hear his own voice too. If you wake while it's still being read, go back and read from the verse where you dozed off, and carry on to the end. Not by day: the custom everywhere today is not to work on Purim day, though at night it's allowed. Yes, search before you leave, in case you get back on Erev Pesach and don't manage to search. If you're not sure you'll be back for Pesach, some say to search anyway and others disagree. 2031-03-24	כ״ט אדר תשצ״א	Rosh Chodesh Nissan	Pesach	I've avoided sugar on Pesach for years. Can I start using it?	Yes, sugar is permitted. 2031-03-30	ו׳ ניסן תשצ״א	Pesach preparation	Pesach	What's the right way to burn the chametz?	The custom is to burn it. 2031-04-03	י׳ ניסן תשצ״א	Pesach preparation	Pesach	How much do I need to drink from each of the four cups?	The cup should hold a revi'it (81 grams). Can I eat something?	Yes. If you were fasting or are hungry, you may eat fruit, rice or matza ashira after Kiddush, but don't fill yourself up. 2031-04-04	י״א ניסן תשצ״א	Pesach preparation	Pesach	How do we break the middle matza at Yachatz?	According to the Sefardi minhag, based on Kabbala, break it by hand, not with a knife, as a poor man would, into the shapes of the letters dalet and vav. The larger vav-shaped piece is kept for the afikoman, and the smaller dalet-shaped piece goes between the whole matzot. If Pesach falls on Shabbat and the nuts weren't added beforehand, you may add them on Shabbat with a change: nuts first, then the date honey. 2031-04-06	י״ג ניסן תשצ״א	Pesach preparation	Pesach	My children don't know how to ask. Do I still tell them the story?	Yes. 2031-04-15	כ״ב ניסן תשצ״א	After Pesach · Omer	Sefirat HaOmer	My son turns bar mitzva in the middle of the Omer. Can he keep counting with a bracha?	No. His counting as a child doesn't count towards a full count as an adult, so from his bar mitzva he should hear the bracha from the chazzan each night and then count with everyone. Have these checked: suits, waistcoats, coats, trousers, wool hats with an inner lining, wool-lined boots, wool scarves, and winter dresses or skirts. Socks, belts, sports shirts, tallitot, kippot, gloves, underwear, towels, felt hats, shoes, pyjamas, earmuffs and fabric bags don't need checking. 2031-04-16	כ״ג ניסן תשצ״א	After Pesach · Omer	Sefirat HaOmer	Could hearing the chazzan count the Omer stop me saying my own bracha?	Possibly, since some hold you fulfil the mitzva just by hearing it, even without meaning to. So at the start of the Omer it's good to say clearly: 'Every night this year I intend not to fulfil the mitzva by hearing the chazzan or anyone else, only when I count myself.' Can I still use it?	Yes. Turn the strap round: tie the yud-shaped knot in its other end and use that end at the top, so the part that had the knot now hangs at the bottom. Using it this way is better than putting it away in geniza. 2031-04-17	כ״ד ניסן תשצ״א	After Pesach · Omer	Sefirat HaOmer	I counted the days but forgot to say the weeks. What now?	From the seventh day the weeks must be counted too, and there's a dispute whether you've fulfilled the mitzva without them. If you realise that night, count again properly without a bracha; if you only realise the next night, carry on counting with a bracha. Only if you know for sure the sun hasn't set yet; then light with a bracha. 2031-07-21	א׳ אב תשצ״א	The Nine Days	Three Weeks / Nine Days	I'm eating a meal before midday on Erev Tisha B'Av. Do the last-meal limits apply?
